description: React component for managing UI theme settings, specifically logo customization within an admin dashboard. It allows users to view, update, and reset the logo URL with fetch calls to backend APIs and integrates with context and notification systems.

methods.name: fetchLogoSettings
methods.description: Fetches current logo settings from backend API and updates component state.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the logo URL input to backend and updates the theme context.

methods.name: handleReset
methods.description: Resets the logo to default by clearing input and backend setting.
